unit_rules.name: The Architect
unit_rules.text: While a +Leader+, ranged weapons equipped by models in the unit have +[Ignores Cover]+.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Architect
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit and not a +Leader+ or +Support+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
